additional_info.subject: RE: ID0432577-DC/Si-D/PL-[Y2/S2 314164726/003] XF3 Router Issue CRM:02889000129
additional_info.body:
The router has a physically bent pin in the power socket, and it is not possible to repair this component. After replacing the router, the station communicates correctly with the SCB again.
In addition, please update the station to 7.0.6. by the previously agreed date.
Szymon
